products.title: Brass ISO 7241-B Female Quick Coupler × NPTF Female
products.focusKeyword: brass iso 7241-b female quick coupler x nptf female
products.descriptionShort: Brass ISO 7241-B Female Quick Coupler × NPTF Female: 3 part numbers, 1/4" to 1/2".
products.descriptionLong:
The Brass ISO 7241-B Female Quick Coupler × NPTF Female is a female coupler (socket) to the ISO 7241-B interchange, machined from brass, with an NPTF female port. ISO 7241-B (ISO-B) is the interchange used on most US and general industrial hydraulic quick couplers; parts to this interchange connect with ISO-B halves from other makers of the same size. Brass suits water, mild chemicals and corrosive surroundings better than plated steel, at a lower pressure.

Specification

  • Interchange: ISO 7241-B
  • Body: brass
  • Port: NPTF female (Dryseal pipe thread, ASME B1.20.3)
  • Temperature: −13 °F to 257 °F (−25 °C to 125 °C), as published

Pressure rating

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for these brass couplers. Brass ISO-B couplers rate well below steel ones of the same size; tell us the working pressure and we will confirm it.

Sizes

3 part numbers, 1/4" to 1/2". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists them.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the coupler type and size. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
